subject: ss-medical-oncology
title: Multiple myeloma and plasma cell disorders

steps.tx: **Multiple myeloma** diagnosis requires clonal bone marrow plasma cells of 10% or more or biopsy-proven plasmacytoma plus at least one CRAB or SLiM myeloma-defining event. Clonal plasma cells secrete monoclonal immunoglobulins and osteoclast-activating factors, resulting in hypercalcaemia, renal insufficiency, normocytic normochromic anaemia, and lytic skeletal lesions. Serum protein electrophoresis and serum free light chain quantification provide essential diagnostic confirmation.

rows: Corrected Ca > 11 mg/dL or > 1 mg/dL above ULN
Serum creatinine > 2 mg/dL or CrCl < 40 mL/min
Hemoglobin > 2 g/dL below LLN or < 10 g/dL
>= 1 osteolytic lesion on skeletal CT or MRI

steps.tx: Biomarkers predicting imminent end-organ failure warrant immediate systemic therapy before irreversible renal or skeletal damage ensues. **SLiM criteria** comprise Sixty percent or greater clonal marrow plasma cells, involved-to-uninvolved serum Free Light Chain ratio 100 or higher, and more than 1 focal MRI bone lesion. Meeting any single SLiM biomarker confers an eighty percent risk of progression to symptomatic CRAB features within two years.

rows: Bone marrow aspirate or core biopsy
Serum free light chain assay (involved >=100 mg/L)

steps.tx: Prognostication integrates tumour burden, renal clearance, and cytogenetic alterations. The **Revised International Staging** System R-ISS incorporates serum beta-2 microglobulin, albumin, LDH, and high-risk cytogenetics del(17p), t(4;14), and t(14;16) into stages 1 to 3. Patients with stage 1 achieve a five-year overall survival of eighty-two percent, while stage 3 carries an inferior five-year overall survival of forty percent.

rows: ISS Stage I (B2M <3.5, Albumin >=3.5), Normal LDH
Neither R-ISS stage I nor stage III
High-risk CA and/or elevated serum LDH

steps.tx: Upfront quadruplet regimens achieve unparalleled rates of deep minimal residual disease negativity. Frontline quadruplet therapy combining anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody **daratumumab** or isatuximab with bortezomib, lenalidomide, and dexamethasone DVRd significantly deepens MRD-negative remissions in GRIFFIN and PERSEUS. In the phase 3 PERSEUS trial, subcutaneous daratumumab quadruplet therapy reduced disease progression or death risk by fifty-eight percent in transplant-eligible candidates.

steps.tx: High-dose alkylating conditioning consolidates initial induction responses. High-dose **melphalan** 200 mg/m2 conditioning followed by autologous stem cell transplantation ASCT remains the standard consolidative therapy for transplant-eligible multiple myeloma in DETERMINATION. In DETERMINATION, early autologous transplantation extended progression-free survival by over twenty months compared to chemotherapy alone, followed by maintenance lenalidomide until disease progression.

steps.tx: Bispecific antibody constructs redirect cytotoxic host T-lymphocytes directly against plasma cells. **Teclistamab** is a BCMAxCD3 bispecific T-cell engager antibody approved for relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma, inducing deep and durable overall response rates exceeding 60% in MajesTEC-1. Teclistamab recruits CD3-positive T-cells to lyse B-cell maturation antigen BCMA-expressing malignant plasma cells. Patients are monitored for cytokine release syndrome and neurotoxicity.

nodes.label: Dual binding (BCMA on myeloma + CD3 on T cell)

steps.tx: Chimeric antigen receptor engineered cellular therapy demonstrates remarkable survival gains in early relapse. **Ciltacabtagene autoleucel** cilta-cel anti-BCMA CAR-T cell therapy demonstrated significant overall survival superiority over standard-of-care pomalidomide regimens in early relapsed myeloma in CARTITUDE-4. Cilta-cel features two heavy-chain camelid single-domain antibodies targeting two distinct epitopes of BCMA, delivering an eighty-four percent reduction in disease progression risk.

points: Approved for myeloma after 1 prior line of therapy

right.title: Standard-of-Care Pomalidomide Triplet

steps.tx: Premalignant plasma cell dyscrasias require watchful surveillance rather than therapeutic intervention. **Monoclonal gammopathy** of undetermined significance MGUS is defined by serum M-protein under 3 g/dL, clonal bone marrow plasma cells under 10%, and complete absence of end-organ damage. MGUS progresses to multiple myeloma or related lymphoproliferative disorders at a rate of approximately one percent per year.
